result.instructions: Tools for Oura, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Oura data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run oura_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run oura_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run oura_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. oura_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: oura_get_personal_info
tools.title: Get personal info
tools.description: Fetch the wearer's profile — age, weight, height, biological sex and email. Oura: GET /v2/usercollection/personal_info.

sandbox.description: Read Oura's synthetic sandbox data instead of the wearer's real data. Use this to learn a response shape without a ring.

tools.name: oura_list_documents
tools.title: List documents from a collection
tools.description: List documents from one Oura collection over a date range. This is the main read: pick `collection` for what you want — daily_sleep and sleep for sleep, daily_readiness for recovery, daily_activity for movement, daily_stress and daily_resilience for load, workout and session for exercise, daily_spo2, daily_cardiovascular_age and vO2_max for cardiovascular measures, tag and enhanced_tag for the wearer's own annotations, rest_mode_period and ring_configuration for device state. Oura: GET /v2/usercollection/{collection}.

start_date.description: Start of the range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to a recent window.

next_token.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_token. Omit for the first page.

sandbox.description: Read Oura's synthetic sandbox data instead of the wearer's real data. Use this to learn a response shape without a ring.

tools.name: oura_get_document
tools.title: Get one document
tools.description: Fetch a single document by id from one collection. Ids come from oura_list_documents. Oura: GET /v2/usercollection/{collection}/{document_id}.

collection.description: Which collection the document belongs to.

sandbox.description: Read Oura's synthetic sandbox data instead of the wearer's real data. Use this to learn a response shape without a ring.

tools.name: oura_get_heartrate
tools.title: Get heart-rate samples
tools.description: Fetch individual heart-rate samples over a DATETIME range. This collection is sampled continuously, so it uses start_datetime/end_datetime rather than dates, and can return a great many points — narrow the window or pass latest. Oura: GET /v2/usercollection/heartrate.

latest.description: Return only the most recent sample.

next_token.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_token. Omit for the first page.

sandbox.description: Read Oura's synthetic sandbox data instead of the wearer's real data. Use this to learn a response shape without a ring.

tools.name: oura_get_ring_battery_level
tools.title: Get ring battery level
tools.description: Fetch ring battery readings over a DATETIME range, or just the latest. Oura: GET /v2/usercollection/ring_battery_level.

latest.description: Return only the most recent reading.

next_token.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_token. Omit for the first page.

sandbox.description: Read Oura's synthetic sandbox data instead of the wearer's real data. Use this to learn a response shape without a ring.

tools.name: oura_list_webhook_subscriptions
tools.title: List webhook subscriptions
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions registered for the application. Oura: GET /v2/webhook/subscription.

tools.name: oura_get_webhook_subscription
tools.title: Get one webhook subscription
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook subscription with its callback URL, event type and expiry. Oura: GET /v2/webhook/subscription/{id}.

tools.name: oura_create_webhook_subscription
tools.title: Create a webhook subscription
tools.description: Register a webhook so Oura notifies your callback URL when data changes. Oura verifies the URL before activating it, and the subscription EXPIRES — renew it with oura_renew_webhook_subscription. Oura: POST /v2/webhook/subscription.

callback_url.description: The HTTPS URL Oura should call.

verification_token.description: A secret Oura echoes back so you can verify the callback.

event_type.description: Which change to be notified about.

data_type.description: Which collection to watch, e.g. daily_sleep or workout.

tools.name: oura_renew_webhook_subscription
tools.title: Renew a webhook subscription
tools.description: Extend a webhook subscription's expiry. Oura subscriptions lapse if not renewed, so this is the tool that keeps a live integration alive. Oura: PUT /v2/webhook/subscription/renew/{id}.

tools.name: oura_delete_webhook_subscription
tools.title: Delete a webhook subscription
tools.description: Remove a webhook subscription. Notifications stop immediately. Oura: DELETE /v2/webhook/subscription/{id}.
